title: Senior QA Engineer
description:
Come work at a place where innovation and teamwork come together to support the most exciting missions in the world!

**Job Description**

We are seeking a highly motivated and talented Senior QA Engineer to work on Qualys’ next-generation data platform and middleware. You will work closely with a team of engineers and architects to design, automate, and execute tests for highly distributed, large-scale systems that power a highly scalable SaaS-based cloud security data platform. This is an excellent opportunity to contribute to Qualys’ next-generation microservices-based technology platform, which processes over 100 million transactions and terabytes of data per day. You will have the chance to leverage open source technologies and work on challenging, business-impacting projects.

This position is based in our Pune office in India and requires close collaboration with QA teams and engineering partners in the Bay Area, California, and North Carolina.

**Responsibilities:**

Work closely with the Data Platform development team to identify, document, and validate defects, monitor fixes, and ensure high-quality releases.

Design, develop, and maintain automated test suites for distributed, large-scale systems.

Contribute to the implementation of the test automation framework and enhance the existing framework for scalability and efficiency.

Collaborate with engineering, DevOps, SecOps, and product teams to ensure platform reliability, quality, and performance.

Perform system-level debugging, log analysis, and root cause investigation for complex issues.

Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and provide input on testability and quality improvements.

Ensure test cases and results are well-documented, traceable, and integrated into CI/CD pipelines.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
* 4 to 8 years of professional experience in Automation Testing using Java with TestNG.
* Strong hands-on experience in automation framework design, implementation, and maintenance.
* Solid experience testing distributed systems, data pipelines, or data platforms.
* Good knowledge of Linux and Shell Scripting.
* Proficiency in test automation using Python and Java.
* Experience with tools such as JUnit, TestNG, Maven, Jenkins, or Pytest.
* Familiarity with containerized environments and orchestration tools (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Experience with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, GitLab CI, or similar.
* Solid understanding of system-level debugging, log analysis, and performance monitoring.
* Knowledge of relational databases and ability to integrate SQL queries into test automation.
* Familiarity with distributed databases such as Cassandra, Kafka, or Redis is a plus.
* Experience with tools like JIRA, GIT, Zephyr.
* Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and ability to work effectively in a collaborative team environment.

title: QA & Testing Lead Engineer, AVP
description:
**Job Description:**
--------------------

**Job Title \-** **QA \& Testing Lead Engineer, AVP**

**Location \- Pune, India**

**Role Description**

* The business which this development team is supporting is the lending department within Private Bank Germany. The whole life cycle for mortgage and consumer loans as well as securitization solutions for these loans is covered within the department and supported by the several teams.
* In the last years we have developed a service layer for common development tasks, the Lending Service Layer (LSL). The Lending Service Layer provides a set of well defined, structured, and reusable Lending Services (APIs) for all internal and external stakeholders. The LSL is in a steady expanding mode to integrate and offer services in a dynamical evolving environment.
* To extend and maintain these services, an experienced Java Developer is required. This role includes the design, implementation, and administration of J2SE/J2EE application code to support business, functional and technical requirements. Furthermore, it includes the analysis of new requirements and supporting business analysts in specifying them in a way that drives reusability and assures that the overall designs are consistent with industry best practices (including scalability, availability, maintainability, and flexibility) and in line with the overall LSL architecture. In case of application issues, the developer should work on analyzing those issues and to neutralize their impacts.
* As an Engineer he is responsible for designing, developing, and delivering significant components of engineering solutions to accomplish business goals. Key responsibilities of this role include active participation in the design of the components, ensuring that solutions are fit for purpose and maintainable, and can be integrated successfully into the overall solution and the LSL environment. Where clear, robust and well tested deployments are in practice.

**What we’ll offer you**

As part of our flexible scheme, here are just some of the benefits that you’ll enjoy


* Best in class leave policy
* Gender neutral parental leaves
* 100% reimbursement under childcare assistance benefit (gender neutral)
* Sponsorship for Industry relevant certifications and education
* Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members
* Comprehensive Hospitalization Insurance for you and your dependents
* Accident and Term life Insurance
* Complementary Health screening for 35 yrs. and above

**Your key responsibilities**

* Test Planning \& Execution:
* Would be expected to carry out below list of Tasks
* Participate on development of holistic Test Approach for the application and all subcomponents
* Build functional/regression tests in Quality Center/ALM
* Carry out test execution and test reporting
* Work on test automation to build regression automation test suite from manual tests and update them for every release.
* Version control artifacts using Bitbucket, Git Hub, Perforce, SVN or any other version control tools
* Schedule automation scripts based on Release cycles.
* Review daily smoke test reports, and Regression test reports. Analyze test failures and raise issues/defects to respective Dev teams.
* Update / Fix test scripts as per the functionality changes
* Achieve good test coverage
* Quality
* Must have good knowledge of the software test best practices and industry standard tools
* Maintaining testing standards and ensure that they adhered to, as well as proactively trying to add these standards whenever possible.
* Taking pride in the quality of software delivered for each iteration and release.
* Communication
* Must be able to communicate effectively with other development team members, project members, managers, and end users.
* Must be able to participate in the discussions within the team, communicating any issues that have a project\-wide scope to the necessary level
* Must be able to participate in a culture of ‘knowledge sharing’ with the development team.
* Motivation
* Must be self\-motivated, setting a high level of professionalism and excellence.

**Your skills and experience**

* You are a senior QA resource with:
* 5\+ Years of functional testing experience
* Good understanding and knowledge of automation testing methodologies
* Good Knowledge of the following: HP ALM, JIRA
* Good knowledge on testing life cycle
* Knowledge in test data maintenance
* Strong working knowledge of SQL and RDBMS databases
* Good knowledge on Unix /Linux environments and basic Unix shell scripting
* Quick learner
* Ability to prioritize and organize
* Results driven – able to deliver good quality accurate solutions to tight time\-scales
* Conscientious – Always give 100% to tasks assigned
* Versatile – Able to multi\-task
* Team Player – Must be able to work with and participate within a large professional team
* Professional – Expect to work the hours the job demands
* Good communication skills
* Good trouble shooting and problem\-solving skills
* It would be desirable for the candidate to have
* ISEB Software Testing Certification – Foundation /Intermediate /Practitioner
* Automated testing skills e.g. Selenium, HP UFT
* Knowledge of Unit Testing and Agile Methodologies Knowledge of scripting (VBScript, Java Scripting, Shell, Perl etc)
* Working experience in Automation and toolset
* You must be highly motivated with an eye for detail, strong communication skills and a track record of delivering successful projects into production.

**Experience / Qualifications:**

* Minimum 5\-8 years relevant experience as QA Engineer within the IT support industry, experience in financial industry preferred.

**Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.**

**How we’ll support you**

* Training and development to help you excel in your career
* Coaching and support from experts in your team
* A culture of continuous learning to aid progression
* A range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your needs

**About us and our teams**

Please visit our company website for further information:


**https://www.db.com/company/company.html**

We strive for a culture in which we are empowered to excel together every day. This includes acting responsibly, thinking commercially, taking initiative and working collaboratively.


Together we share and celebrate the successes of our people. Together we are Deutsche Bank Group.


We welcome applications from all people and promote a positive, fair and inclusive work environment.

* Continuously research and recommend tools and frameworks to enhance the automation process.
* Develop strategies for testing complex features and functionality.

**What you bring**

* 3 to 7 years of experience in Selenium automation testing and Java programming.
* Strong understanding of software QA methodologies, tools, and processes.
* Experience with TestNG and BDD frameworks.

* Excellent problem\-solving and analytical skills.
* Ability to work effectively within a team and independently.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.

* Salesforce
